name: leash
description: Use your connected accounts through Leash with configurable protections, activity history and undo for supported actions.

interface.shortDescription: A little peace of mind for your AI.
interface.longDescription: Connect your accounts to Leash, choose what your AI can do, and review activity in one place. Leash checks supported actions that pass through its gateway. Undo is available for supported reversible actions when enabled. It does not monitor other tools or browser activity. Free.
defaultPrompt: Check that Leash is connected without accessing my personal accounts.
Help me set up my Leash protections.
